text:
Jess (Support): Customer escalated — compact/mobile dashboard issue. On small screens the legend rows appear swapped and tooltips show values from a different series/time. Customer: acme-inc, ticket C-12941. Started after analytics deploy (~09:37 UTC). Screenshot: https://s3.redwood-inference.internal/support/C-12941/screen1.png
Alex (Product): Can you paste repro steps + device/browser? Native app or mobile web? Any HAR/video?
Jess (Support): Repro steps:
1) Open dashboard 'Quota usage' in compact mode on phone
2) Set time range: Last 30 minutes
3) On iPhone 12 / Safari tap legend entries to toggle
Observed: legend visually swaps rows (order out of sync with series color/labels). Tooltips for points show values that belong to a different series (seems shifted). Also seeing delayed metrics for the most recent 10m (data lag ~2-3m).
Trace/links: trace_id: d3f9a7b4, HAR: https://s3.redwood-inference.internal/support/C-12941/repro.har, Video: https://s3.redwood-inference.internal/support/C-12941/repro.mp4
Console snippet copied from customer session:
```
[analytics] renderLegend() took 12ms
TypeError: cannot read property 'seriesIndex' of undefined at legend.js:342
```
Sam (Eng-Frontend): Thanks. Can you confirm this started after analytics v2 deploy? Need the deploy hash/time. Also, does this happen in desktop compact (responsive) or only native mobile browsers?
OpsBot: Deploy analytics-service@v2.1.4 (hash 3f2a1b) completed 2026-10-12T09:37:22Z by ci/pipeline #5012
Jess (Support): Customer says it appeared shortly after that deploy window. Affected: mobile web (Safari) and one report from Android Chrome in compact layout. Not seen on full desktop.
Sam (Eng-Frontend): Assigning to me to triage. Hypothesis: a regression in compact legend sort key or a race between legend render and series metadata binding. Quick experiment for customer: try forcing legacy legend behavior in console:
```
window.REDWOOD_FLAGS = window.REDWOOD_FLAGS || {};
window.REDWOOD_FLAGS.preferLegacyLegend = true;
location.reload();
```
If that prevents row swapping it's likely a sorting regression introduced in v2.1.4.
Marta (Mobile): I'll reproduce on iPhone 12 (Safari) and Pixel 4a (Chrome) emulators. If webview, please send app version/code.
Alex (Product): Marking P2 for now. If more customers impacted or data corruption observed escalate to P1. Please update ticket C-12941 with repro steps and temporary workaround.
Jess (Support): Added workaround and notes to C-12941, customer accepted temporary flag change. Also collected list of affected orgs (3 accounts so far).
Sam (Eng-Frontend): Found probable NPE at legend.js:342 where seriesIndex can be undefined when compact reordering runs before series metadata resolves. I'll patch with guard and add unit/integration tests around compact reflow. ETA ~3h for a hotfix branch.
Marta (Mobile): Verified reproduce on iOS simulator, attached simulator logs to the ticket. Looks consistent with Sam's NPE.
Jess (Support): Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll ping customer with ETA and keep them updated.
Sam (Eng-Frontend): Will open PR and link here once ready. Leaving note to monitor analytics deploy rollback option if any regression shows broader impact.
Alex (Product): Good plan. Keep this thread updated with PR and verification steps so support can close after release verification.
Jess (Support): Noted — will wait for PR and then run through verification steps against staging.
